statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The 12:30 UTC core inflation binary resolved in line, so Tail stays below the block threshold, while Stress remains elevated on a mildly hawkish data composition and an imminent cash open.
recommendation: Observed conditions are consistent with a resolved inflation checkpoint and an as-yet unobserved post-release price path. The 13:30 UTC cash open and the after-close NVIDIA report are the evidence-based checkpoints at which the mapped state may change; the assessment is refreshed hourly.
headline: Core PCE lands in line at 0.2% and 3.3%, keeping Tail low while the post-print NQ path is still unobserved
body: The clustered 12:30 UTC release has printed. Core PCE rose 0.2% MoM and held at 3.3% YoY, matching consensus on both measures, so the specific hawkish-shock scenario flagged in earlier hours did not occur. The composition is nonetheless mildly firm: headline PCE was 0.2% MoM and 3.7% YoY, each a tenth above consensus, durable goods orders jumped 1.1% against a 0.5% forecast, personal income rose 0.4% against 0.2%, and the Q2 GDP second estimate confirmed a slowdown to 1.5% in line with expectations. Immediately before the release NQ futures were mid-band at 29,219, about -0.2%, inside a two-sided 29,096-29,310 overnight range that had been rejected in both directions, with VIX at 15.65 in a very narrow 15.60-15.74 band, Treasury futures flat across the curve, and WTI near $80.15 and Brent near $85.85 after a third consecutive decline on Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz corridor diplomacy. The 10-year yield was near 4.65% with the curve about two basis points higher into the print, against the latest H.15 observation of 4.24% at 2 years, 4.70% at 10 years and 5.23% at 30 years. No accessible delayed feed yet carries a verified post-12:30 UTC price path, so the immediate reaction is treated as an evidence gap rather than as either an orderly or a pathological outcome; that gap is reflected in Confidence rather than in Tail. With no observed directional efficiency, no session-extreme holding, no chain of shallow pullbacks and no cross-asset stress alignment, Tail remains in the low band and the mapped policy state is EA_ON. Stress stays elevated because the data composition can still support a yield-led second leg, the 13:30 UTC cash open follows within the hour, and NVIDIA reports after the 20:00 UTC close as the Jackson Hole symposium opens. The danger window is kept narrow around the active repricing and the first cash half-hour, and conditional Tail returns to the watch band later for the after-close report, where a delayed second leg through guidance is the specific structural concern.

lookbackSummary: The 24 previously published hours describe a calm regime running into today's event stack. Tail sat at 20-21 in the watch band through Tuesday's European session with a trend-up mode, fell through the Tuesday US cash session to 9-12, and then held at 11 for the entire overnight window with a normal dominant mode, so the mapped state has been EA_ON continuously since 14:00 UTC on 25 August. Stress drifted from the mid-40s to 57 as the Wednesday release cluster approached, while Confidence held at 87-88 throughout.
outlookSummary: With the inflation binary resolved in line, the horizon is defined by the 13:30 UTC cash open and the after-close AI report rather than by any observed trend. Conditional Tail holds the watch band for the opening hour, where opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the first genuine amplifier, then decays through the afternoon as the reaction is assumed to mature. It returns to the top of the watch band for the 20:00-22:00 UTC NVIDIA release and guidance call, where a delayed second leg in thin post-close liquidity is the structural concern, and falls back to the low-band baseline overnight as Asian then European hours favour range formation. Confidence is modelled progressively lower across the horizon because that evidence is calendar structure rather than price path. Thursday's 12:30 UTC jobless claims sits immediately beyond this window, and the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote on Friday at 14:00 UTC, alongside the preliminary payrolls benchmark revision at the same instant, is the next high-impact checkpoint.
